limitations: Frame correlation: no IID p-values or confidence guarantee.
VAL repeatedly exposed: development evidence only.
TRAIN-only direction selection is descriptive; no score deployment.
Small error counts cannot establish absence of all nonlinear information.
No candidate trained, no geometry or policy changed.
matching: Low-deviation errors matched to nearest low-deviation correct within same video and absolute relative-log-size distance<=.1. Controls may be reused, disclose unmatched/errors/control count; not independent pairs.
roles: Full TRAIN fixes feature quartiles/median and descriptive orientation, saved before full exposed VAL. No new roles, fits, thresholds or TEST.
screen: Descriptive prerequisite only: same feature has TRAIN-directed low-deviation AUC>=.6 with >=5 errors and >=5 correct in >=2 TRAIN videos and >=1 VAL video; 4 median-by-original-temporal cells each >=5 errors and >=5 correct, signed interaction contrast abs>=.1 agrees in >=2 TRAIN and >=1 VAL videos. No automatic model fitting. These conservative screening constants are not confidence bounds or a proof of information absence.
